answer: The copper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the opal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
